steps: Read the authority CSV with an RFC 4180-compatible CSV parser.
Use the 27 immutable source schema columns in the exact specified order.
Treat each cell as the exact string returned by the CSV parser.
Do not trim, apply Unicode normalization, reparse JSON, or sort reason codes.
Preserve an empty cell as the empty string "".
Serialize each row as a JSON array [value_of_pair_id,value_of_canonical_none_row_id,...,value_of_automatic_evidence].
JSON serialization is UTF-8 without BOM, ensure_ascii = false, allow_nan = false, separators = [",",":"], and no trailing newline.
Use the SHA-256 lowercase hex of that UTF-8 byte sequence as source_record_sha256.
F2_source_record_sha256_contract.cell_handling: exact string returned by CSV parser; empty cell preserved as empty string

F2_decision_meanings.CANONICAL_TEXTUAL_REPAIR_CANDIDATE: Canonical semantics are preserved but surface grammar/text defect exists; repair candidate generation, triple reconstruction or derivative revalidation, and separate audit are required before any admission.
F2_decision_meanings.CANONICAL_REGENERATION_REQUIRED: Canonical member and derivative authority must be newly generated; existing triple is not reused as-is.
F2_decision_meanings.SEMANTIC_CONFLICT: Canonical/paraphrase/polarity-flip relationship conflicts with the intended transformation contract; automatic repair and regeneration are not approved.
F2_decision_meanings.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_KEEP_BLOCKED: Current artifacts are insufficient for semantic or remediation conclusion; blocked state remains.
F2_decision_meanings.NO_REPRODUCIBLE_DEFECT_KEEP_BLOCKED: Human review could not reproduce the P3-W4 automatic grammar defect; this does not prove correctness, recoverability, training admission, or polarity supervision eligibility, and the pair remains blocked until separate authority resolution.
